s.note: grabbed on the run between riddles
s.how: Soften the onion in the oil, then brown the mince with the curry powder, thyme and salt. Add the stock and simmer until almost dry, then stir in the breadcrumbs and cool. Heat the oven to 200C. Brush the pastry sheets with turmeric mixed into the beaten egg and cut two 12cm rounds from each. Spoon the filling onto half of each round, fold over and crimp with a fork. Brush the tops with the rest of the egg. Bake on lined trays until golden and flaky, about 25 minutes. Serve hot with hot sauce.

s.n: Bacon egg and cheese on a roll
s.note: Crisp bacon, fried egg and melted cheese in a toasted roll.
s.how: Fry 8 rashers bacon until crisp. Fry 4 eggs in the same pan, breaking the yolks, and lay a slice of American cheese on each to melt. Split and butter 4 kaiser rolls and toast them. Fill with 2 rashers bacon and an egg each, season with salt and pepper and add tomato sauce.

m.note: Buttermilk fried chicken on waffles with hot honey.
m.how: Soak 600g boneless chicken thighs in 300ml buttermilk with 1 tsp salt for 2 hours. Dredge in 200g flour with 1 tsp paprika and fry at 175C for 7 minutes until 74C inside. Cook 8 small waffles from a 300g mix. Warm 100ml honey with 2 tsp hot sauce and drizzle over the chicken on the waffles.

w.note: Chewy brown sugar caramel packed with roasted salted peanuts, set in a slab and topped with milk chocolate and flaky salt.
w.how: Line a 20cm square tin. Heat 200g brown sugar, 100g butter, 150ml cream and 2 tbsp golden syrup, stirring, then boil 6 to 8 minutes to 118C. Stir in 200g roasted salted peanuts and pour into the tin. Cool 30 minutes, spread with 150g melted milk chocolate and sprinkle with flaky salt. Chill 2 hours and cut into squares.

d.note: Fresh lemonade in a big jug, measured to exactly four litres.
d.how: Dissolve 300g caster sugar in 300ml hot water and cool. Add 400ml lemon juice, about 10 lemons, and top up with cold water to exactly 4 litres. Work it out with a 5 litre and a 3 litre jug if you're feeling brave. Serve over ice.
